params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Both {{ci|Lamb}} and {{ci|Wolf}} mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a permanent stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''. '''Lamb''' can select an enemy {{tip|champion}} to ''hunt'', and '''Wolf''' automatically selects a large {{tip|monster}} to ''hunt''.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''. For each stack, {{cis|Kindred}} abilities become more potent.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Both '''Lamb''' and '''Wolf''' mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

{{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Lamb:}} '''Lamb''' is offered a selection of enemy {{tip|champions}} to ''hunt'' if she has not been [[combat status|in combat]] with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by '''Kindred'''. '''Lamb''' gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. ''Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.''
params.notes:
* The selection of enemy champions to mark is offered through a special menu in the HUD that displays the portraits of up to 5 enemy champions. The player can mark an enemy by {{LMB}} clicking on their portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}).
** Marked enemies have a trim around their portrait. Unavailable selections are greyed out. 
** The portraits are ordered based on their spawn ID.
* {{tip|Takedown|Takedowns}} on {{tip|monsters}} occur if '''Kindred''' had damaged them within the last 6 seconds.
** This only includes if the monster was slain by '''Kindred''' or an ally.
* Only killing the large monster is required to claim '''Wolf's''' mark.
* Gaining stacks from champions that would change what constitutes a valid target for '''Wolf''' will not affect '''Kindred's''' ability to claim '''Wolf's''' current target.
* '''Wolf''' cannot mark monsters that have been slain, even if '''Kindred's''' team doesn't know that the camp has been slain. 
* '''Wolf's''' cooldown is not displayed in-game. Combined with the above point and the target restrictions, '''Wolf''' may go extended periods of time without seeming to do anything. 
* '''Wolf's''' marked target will always have its mark removed from the map 15 seconds after dying for both teams, regardless of whether they have vision of it or not.

blurb.plain: Innate: Both Lamb and Wolf mark targets to hunt. Scoring a takedown against a hunted target collects a permanent stack of Mark of the Kindred. Lamb can select an enemy champion to hunt, and Wolf automatically selects a large monster to hunt.

blurb4.plain: Mark of the Kindred: Lamb gains bonus range on her basic attacks and Mounting Dread. For each stack, Kindred abilities become more potent.

description.plain: Innate: Both Lamb and Wolf mark targets to hunt. Scoring a takedown against a hunted target collects a stack of Mark of the Kindred. Mark of the Kindred: Lamb gains 75 – 250 (based on marks) bonus range on her basic attacks and Mounting Dread.

description2.plain: Innate - Lamb: Lamb is offered a selection of enemy champions to hunt if she has not been in combat with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by Kindred. Lamb gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.

description3.plain:
Innate - Wolf: Starting at 2:53, Wolf periodically marks a random large monster within the enemy team's jungle for 180 seconds. The hunted camp is highlighted on the mini map to both teams. Once the hunted target is slain or the mark expires, Wolf will wait 45 seconds before selecting a new target. The type of monster that Wolf can mark changes based on Kindred's current Mark of the Kindred stacks:
* 0 : Rift Scuttler
* 1 – 3: Rift Scuttler, Crimson Raptor, Gromp
* 4 – 7: Ancient Krug, Blue Sentinel, Greater Murk Wolf, or Red Brambleback
* 8 + : Rift Herald or Baron Nashor, Dragon or Elder Dragon

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} As {{ci|Kindred}} move and attack, they build up stacks of ''Hunter's Vigor''. At full stacks, {{cis|Lamb}} next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wolf}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and occupies the area for a period. He attacks enemies within the area, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, '''Wolf's''' attacks deal increased damage and {{tip|slow}} the target for a short time.
params.blurb3: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Lamb''' generates 1 stack of ''Hunter's Vigor'' for every {{tt|27 units|Estimated}} she travels by any means and 5 stacks {{tip|on-attack}}, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her for {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 25|0 to 80|formula= 1.25% per 1% of '''Kindred's missing''' health. ''This is capped at 80% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''Missing''' health|type='''Kindred's''' '''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|changedisplay = true}}}} of {{pplevel|47 to 81|color=heal}}. The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wolf''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, then claims the surrounding area as his territory for the next {{fd|8.5}} seconds, separating from '''Lamb'''. He automatically attacks the closest nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
params.description3: '''Wolf's''' attacks deal {{as|magic damage}} and the rate at which he attacks scale with {{as|25% of '''Kindred's bonus''' attack speed}}. Against monsters, his attacks deal 165% damage and {{tip|slow}} the target by 50% for 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{fd|112.5}} {{as|(+ 15 per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} against monsters.
params.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% {{as|(+ 1% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}|Monster Damage|{{ap|25*1.65 to 45*1.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.65}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.65}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*1.65}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*1.65}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
params.description4: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.
params.notes:
* ''Hunter's Vigor's'' heal is not triggered on attacks against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* '''Wolf''' is {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} but he cannot move through terrain other than the initial dash on activation. 
* '''Wolf''' is not able to re-target {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} if he loses {{tip|sight}} of her while he's attacking it.
* '''Wolf''' grants the same {{tip|sight|vision}} as a {{tip|champion}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' does not end if '''Lamb''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' applies ability haste to its cooldown post-effect.
** Given a base cooldown of 14 seconds at rank 5 with 100 ability haste, casting the ability and then ending it after 4 seconds will result in a remaining cooldown of <math>(14 - 4) \times 0.5 = 5</math> seconds, where 0.5 is [[Haste#Formula|derived from ability haste]].
** Because of this, there will always be some cooldown time remaining post-effect regardless of the amount of ability haste, unlike certain other abilities with cooldowns that start on-cast.
* {{Pending for test}}: Interaction with enemy vision and spectator mode.
params.tips: * '''Wolf''' can be used to get {{tip|sight|vision}} over walls.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lamb}} blesses the ground under herself for a few seconds. Any unit inside the area will become {{tip|invulnerable}} upon reaching {{tip|minimum health threshold|low health}}.
params.blurb2: Units within the area are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' blesses the ground underneath herself, creating a sacred zone at the location that lasts for 4 seconds. {{tt|'''All''' units|Ally, enemy, and neutral}} inside the zone gain a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} equal to {{as|{{sti|health|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and will also become {{tip|invulnerable}} while remaining in the area when they reach or are at the threshold, during which they also cannot be {{tip|heal|healed}}, but can still {{sti|health regeneration|regenerate health|link=health regeneration}}.
params.description3: All targetable units within the zone are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
params.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 120}}|Begins at start of cast time}}
params.notes:
* ''Lamb's Respite's'' effects are applied before the cast time.
* ''Lamb's Respite'' will affect all {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|monsters}}, but not {{tip|ward|wards}}, {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or [[jungle plants]].
* ''Lamb's Respite'' will affect {{tip|untargetable}} units but does not grant them the {{tip|heal}} at the end of the blessing.
** It will specifically not affect champions that are {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}} from {{ii|Guardian Angel}}.
* {{tip|Health resource|Health costs}} will ignore ''Lamb's Respite's'' threshold.
** The cost will not be paid if the caster is below the threshold.
* ''Lamb's Respite'' has no effect on {{tip|zombie state}} or {{tip|clone}} units.
* {{pending for test}} ''Lamb's Respite'' will have no effect if cast while '''Kindred''' is {{tip|untargetable}}.
